title: Cam Heyward: Jared Verse calling Steelers "dirty" will be addressed Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Heyward: Jared Verse calling Steelers "dirty" will be addressed Sunday
sources.description: Dislike between the Browns and Steelers has been brewing for decades, so there isn't much need for any one player to fan the flames of the bad feelings between the two AFC North teams.
